$sources: KDS 41 17 00:2019 4.2.1 (site classes S1-S6, Fa and Fv by S, SDS = 2.5 S Fa × 2/3, SD1 = S Fv × 2/3), 4.2.2 (design spectrum), 6.2 (R, Cd, Ω0); the rest of the seismic rules as the base pack (ASCE 7-22, the same numbers: see VERIFY.md)
source: KDS 41 17 00:2019 (the ASCE 7 form with the Korean site classes) on the base pack's seismic rules

S1.description: Site class S1: rock (soil over rock less than 1 m)

S2.description: Site class S2: shallow stiff soil (depth to bedrock up to 20 m, soil vs at least 260 m/s)

S3.description: Site class S3: shallow soft soil (depth to bedrock up to 20 m, soil vs below 260 m/s)

S4.description: Site class S4: deep stiff soil (depth to bedrock over 20 m, soil vs at least 180 m/s)

S5.description: Site class S5: deep soft soil (depth to bedrock over 20 m, soil vs below 180 m/s)

S6.description: Site class S6: soils needing a site-specific study

siteCoefficients.clause: KDS 41 17 00 4.2.1.3, Tables 4.2-3 and 4.2-4 (Fa, Fv at S = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3; the Fa points are SS = 2.5 S)

siteSpecificStudy.warning: Site class {classes}: {code} {clause} requires a site-specific study. Until one is made, the design spectrum and the category use site class {assumed}: an assumption, not a value of the code.

sources.siteClasses: KDS 41 17 00:2019 Table 4.2-1: S1-S6 by the depth to bedrock and the soil's average shear wave speed (as SAEngine reads it; VERIFY.md K4); S6 needs a site-specific study (assumed S5 meanwhile, SAEngine practice)
sources.defaultSiteClass: SAEngine practice: S4 where the site class is not known (check KDS 41 17 00 4.2.1.2)
sources.designSpectrum.siteCoefficients: KDS 41 17 00 Tables 4.2-3 and 4.2-4 (uncertain, VERIFY.md K5, K6): Fa, Fv by S at 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 (linear between, the end values beyond)
